references.context: Commutative algebra: residue field of a local ring as quotient by the maximal ideal
Polynomial algebra: polynomial in one indeterminate with leading coefficient equal to 1

references.phrase: simple zero of reduced polynomial f-bar over κ
references.context: Polynomial algebra: simple root of the coefficientwise reduction of f modulo m

references.phrase: lifting a residue field root to R
references.context: Henselian algebra: element a∈R reducing modulo m to a-bar and satisfying f(a)=0

references.phrase: every monic polynomial and every simple zero
references.disposition: The quantifiers range over all eligible pairs; multiple roots in κ are not covered by this simple-root criterion.

review_rationale: Read the exact simple-root lifting condition: a root of the reduced monic polynomial mod maximal ideal lifts to R with the same residue. A simple root is not an arbitrary zero and polynomial monicity is a substantive hypothesis.
